view.summary: An endless runner: Ade dashes forward on her own while you jump obstacles and pits and swing from chandeliers on a rope. Collect coins for score and stat upgrades; go as far as you can before HP runs out.

overview.title: A run
items: Tap (or Space) to jump. While in the air, hold to shoot a rope; once it hooks a chandelier, the swing flings Ade upward — hold longer to go higher.
HP reaches 0, or Ade falls into a pit
Drains every second (10–15 HP a second, rising with difficulty) and drops further when Ade hits an obstacle
Ade slows to 50% speed for 0.3 s and can’t be hurt for 2 s
Can be fired again 0.3 s after the last one

overview.title: Score and coins
items: Distance score plus coin score (distance score ratio 100)
Add up over all runs and earn SP to spend on Ade’s stats (see Stats)

overview.title: Items on the course
overview.note: Coin spots on the course sometimes hold an item instead (chance per spot shown).
items: Restores HP (the Recovery stat sets how much) — 0.05–0.15%
Pulls in every item on screen — 0.3%
Blocks one hit from an obstacle (lasts up to 8 s) — up to 0.3%

overview.title: Rush mode
items: Collecting 4 blueprint fragments sends Ade onto the hidden Coin Rush route
Speed 25, no HP drain, a course packed with coins

pages.title: About MADE IN RUSH
pages.text:
■ This is a mini game where you can experience Ade's spy training.
■ If her HP hits 0 or she falls off a cliff, it's game over!
■ HP automatically decreases over time and significantly decreases when colliding with obstacles.
■ Control Ade to dodge obstacles and leap over cliffs. See how far you can go!

pages.title: Move and Jump
pages.text:
■ Ade moves forward automatically with no extra controls needed.
■ Tap anywhere or press the space bar to jump.
■ Jump to dodge obstacles or leap over small cliffs.

pages.title: Rope Launch and Maneuvers
pages.text:
■ While jumping, press and hold anywhere on the screen or hold the space bar to launch a rope.
■ Once it hooks onto the chandelier, use the rebound to propel yourself upward.
■ The longer you hold, the higher you can propel yourself.

pages.title: Stats
pages.text:
■ Collect coins in the game to earn coin points, which can be used to upgrade your stats.

HP: Increases Ade's max HP.
DEFENSE: Reduces damage taken when Ade collides with obstacles.
RECOVERY: Increases the amount of HP restored when collecting chocolate.

pages.title: Spy Tools
pages.text:
■ Spy tools provide Ade with useful effects.
■ Meet specific conditions to unlock them.
■ The effects of unlocked spy tools can be stacked and applied simultaneously.

pages.title: Items
pages.text:
■ While progressing through the field, useful items that'll help you during gameplay will appear.
■ Collect these items to gain an advantage in the mini game.

Magnet: Sucks in all items visible on the screen.
Chocolate: Restores Ade's HP.
Shield: Provides temporary immunity to damage from obstacles. Can only be used once.
Blueprint Fragment: Collect 4 to enter the hidden route in Coin Rush.
